posts.t:
What about this?

There is a final engulf that occurs on the way down, prior to the fakeout. Price decides to fakeout, and price engulfs the decision to fakeout on its way back up. The engulf of the DP to FO creates a FL/FTR which is the first time significant buy orders took control. This area contains buy orders, so when price engulfs to the upside later on it returns to pick up the remaining orders.

در مسیر نزول یک اینگالف نهایی رخ می‌دهد، پیش از فیک‌اوت. قیمت تصمیم می‌گیرد فیک‌اوت کند و قیمت در مسیر بازگشت به بالا، تصمیم به فیک‌اوت را اینگالف می‌کند. اینگالف DP به FO یک FL/FTR می‌سازد که اولین باری است که سفارش‌های خرید معنادار کنترل را به دست می‌گیرند. این ناحیه سفارش خرید دارد، پس وقتی قیمت بعداً به سمت بالا اینگالف می‌کند برای برداشتن سفارش‌های باقی‌مانده برمی‌گردد.

Is this what Salivan is talking about when he says: "When price is forming a FL after engulfing a different FL, the extreme edge of the return is very often a reaction to another flag limit"

Hello H and fellow RTM colleagues,

H your posts have been extremely helpful, thanks a lot for all the effort you put there. I’m squeezing my brain cells here with Salivan’s puzzle.

This will be my attempt, please keep in mind that I am a complete rookie and what I will share below could be a load of crap. I first tried to analyse the reasons for big retrace/small retrace after engulf with a reason of having compression but then I came to something else. I have recreated Salivan’s chart below

The question marks on the chart point to the big retrace in 2 after eng of 2 and to the small retraces in 1 & 3 after engulf of 1 & 3.

As I understood flag limits, we must consider the top of the engulfing move (A) into the deepest retrace (B) b4 the move out of the initial engulfing area (C).

Now in my head at C a decision was made to leave FL 2 and go higher. That is also a FL with a low of 237.650… Same logic applies to 1 and 3. However when we trace those decisions followed by tracing the decisions that break them in the opposite direction, something important shows up.

Another FL (TONY) appears and it is responsible for keeping price down. At this point we don’t know what will happen, but when point B gets engulfed, this is when FL (TONY) must be revisited by price because it is high up and can be traded down beyond FL 2. But why??? Because again the decision to leave Tony and go lower to engulf happened there…

Same thing for 1 Georges leaves 1 and then gets engulfed by Jack. WAIT!!! Look at this… 1 hadn’t engulfed yet BUT that comes together with when price decides to leave Jack = HUGE DECISION!!!!! Highlighted with a circle.

You guessed it… same thing for 3 with Lisa and Bella.

Now for the biggie…. Would I trade it? It depends on approach and reaction because that important area has been visited quite a few times and spiked lately as well. But if I was forced to trade at gun point I’d go for the QM in pink.

Please wait for SALIVAN to correct this or throw it in the bin altogether!!! H thank you for your hospitality, and forgive my long post.
